title: criterion-add-spec
description: INPUT of `dmtool -m <model> criterion add <spec.json>` and of the `criterion add` apply op — ONE document uniqueness criterion in the exact shape A12 stores it in `content.documentUniquenessCriteria`, so an entry returned by `criterion read` is a valid spec. A criterion names fields whose values no two stored documents may share; it is model data only, and no rule, computation or document validation evaluates it. Only `name` is demanded here: `criterion read`/`remove` address a criterion by it, and a name the model already uses is refused (RK_NAME_EXISTS). Everything else is A12's consistency check to admit, in its own sentence: each field must be required, persisted and outside any repeatable group, named by its full path, and each model locale needs a text whose `$path$` parameters name only the criterion's fields.

name.description: the criterion's name, unique within the model; `criterion read <name>` and `criterion remove <name>` address it by this

fields.description: the fields whose combined values must be unique across stored documents, in order

errorMessage.description: the error text per locale, one entry for every locale the model declares

locale.description: a locale code the model declares, e.g. en_US

text.description: the message; a `$/Full/Path.value$` parameter may name only one of the criterion's own fields
